summary: Unidentified man fell down a rock face into a pond at Red Rock Canyon Open Space (between the Red Rock Canyon and Greenlee trails near the main parking lot) and did not resurface; CSFD water search (8 divers, CSPD drone support) ran the evening of Aug 17 with no results, switched to recovery with sonar, and pulled the body from the water ~10:30 a.m. Aug 18.
location: Red Rock Canyon Open Space pond, Colorado Springs
responding_agency: Colorado Springs Fire Department; Colorado Springs Police Department
notes: Article: mission started evening Tuesday 2021-08-17 (weekday-verified), body recovered mid-morning Wednesday 2021-08-18. Run 640 EPSO chunk; parent-opened this run. Victim unidentified as of publication.
